sources.title: The 90-9-1 rule for participation inequality in social media and online communities
Building Successful Online Communities: Evidence-Based Social Design

concepts.definition: Planned activity of growing, engaging, moderating and supporting a group around a brand or person.
The pattern in which a small share of members creates most of the content.
Written rules that set expectations and make moderation fair.

questions.a: A heuristic that about 90% of members only read, 9% contribute occasionally and 1% create most content.

questions.q: Why should legitimate criticism not be deleted?
questions.a: Deleting it usually makes things worse; responding and solving the problem shows care to all readers.

questions.q: What three things should be prepared before a social media crisis?
questions.a: Who decides and speaks, fast approval paths, and holding statements, plus pausing scheduled posts and ads.
